args.sql:
WITH interference_score AS (
    SELECT 
        telescref AS telescope_id,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN interflvl ILIKE '%high%' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS interference_score
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY telescref
),
average_interference_score AS (
    SELECT AVG(interference_score) AS average_interference
    FROM interference_score
)
SELECT 
    telescope_id,
    interference_score
FROM interference_score
WHERE interference_score > (
    SELECT average_interference
    FROM average_interference_score
);

WITH interference_score AS (
    SELECT 
        telescref AS telescope_id,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN interflvl ILIKE '%high%' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS interference_score
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY telescref
),
average_interference_score AS (
    SELECT AVG(interference_score) AS average_interference
    FROM interference_score
)
SELECT 
    t.telescregistry,
    i.interference_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN i.interference_score > a.average_interference THEN 'High Interference'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS equipment_status
FROM telescopes t
JOIN interference_score i ON t.telescregistry = i.telescope_id
CROSS JOIN average_interference_score a;
